description: This file implements network write operations, including handling different system-specific sendfile implementations, writev, mmap, and error handling for a server application. It provides functions for writing data chunks, file chunks, and initializing network write handlers based on system capabilities.

methods.name: network_write_error
methods.description: Handles network write errors, returning specific codes based on system error or Windows socket errors.

methods.name: network_remove_finished_chunks
methods.description: Removes finished chunks from the chunkqueue.

methods.name: network_write_data_len
methods.description: Writes data to a socket, using send() on Windows and write() on other systems.

methods.name: network_write_accounting
methods.description: Updates max bytes and chunkqueue after a write operation, handling errors.

methods.name: network_write_mem_chunk
methods.description: Writes a memory chunk to the socket.

methods.name: network_write_file_chunk_no_mmap
methods.description: Reads a file chunk into a buffer and writes it to the socket.

methods.name: network_write_file_chunk_mmap
methods.description: Uses mmap to send a file chunk directly.

methods.name: network_write_chunkqueue_writev
methods.description: Writes multiple chunks using writev or WSASend.

methods.name: network_write_file_chunk_sendfile
methods.description: Uses sendfile or platform-specific variants to send file chunks.

methods.name: network_write_chunkqueue_sendfile
methods.description: Sends chunks using sendfile or its variants, depending on system.

methods.name: network_write_init
methods.description: Initializes network write handler based on server configuration and system capabilities.

methods.name: network_write_show_handlers
methods.description: Returns a string describing available network handlers and system support.
